target.title: Expose legacy plugin manifest doctor lint findings
target.body:
## Summary

- expose legacy plugin manifest contract migrations as structured Doctor lint findings
- keep `core/doctor/legacy-plugin-manifests` default-disabled so default `doctor --lint` behavior is unchanged
- leave real manifest rewriting in the existing `openclaw doctor --fix` legacy repair path

## Contract / compatibility notes

No public config, plugin manifest, SDK, persisted data-model, or repair-path contract changes. This PR only maps already-detected legacy manifest state into `HealthFinding` output for explicit lint selection / `--all`.

## Validation

- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.ts src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.ts src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:core`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `node scripts/sync-plugin-sdk-exports.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
Legacy plugin manifests with top-level capability keys such as `tools` are now visible as structured Doctor lint findings when explicitly selected, while default lint remains unchanged.

Real environment tested:
Ubuntu 24.04 WSL worktree at `fd452674f19b108871b81557ca39f52db57415c9`, using the source CLI entrypoint `node --import tsx src/entry.ts` with isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, isolated `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`, and a temp plugin load path containing a manifest with top-level `tools`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Created a temp config with `plugins.load.paths` pointing at a temp plugin root.
2. Wrote `openclaw.plugin.json` with `id: "legacy-plugin"` and top-level `tools: ["legacy_tool"]`.
3. Ran `doctor --lint --json` through the source CLI.
4. Ran `doctor --lint --json --only core/doctor/legacy-plugin-manifests` through the source CLI.

Evidence after fix:
```json
{
  "defaultCode": 1,
  "defaultChecksRun": 25,
  "defaultChecksSkipped": 12,
  "defaultLegacyManifestFindings": 0,
  "onlyCode": 1,
  "onlyChecksRun": 1,
  "onlyChecksSkipped": 36,
  "onlyFindingSummary": {
    "severity": "warning",
    "target": "legacy-plugin",
    "requirement": "contracts-capability-keys",
    "pathEndsWithManifest": true,
    "fixHint": "Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to rewrite legacy plugin manifest capability keys under contracts.*."
  },
  "defaultStderr": "",
  "onlyStderr": ""
}
```

Observed result after fix:
Default lint emitted zero `core/doctor/legacy-plugin-manifests` findings. Explicit `--only core/doctor/legacy-plugin-manifests` ran one selected check and reported the legacy manifest warning for `legacy-plugin`.

What was not tested:
Packaged `dist/entry.js` CLI was not tested in this source worktree; `openclaw.mjs` correctly refused to run before a package build because `dist/entry.js` is absent. The behavior was verified through the source CLI entrypoint and focused Doctor tests.


### Dry-run repair preview update - 2026-07-02

Added structured repair support for the legacy plugin manifest lint finding so `doctor fix --dry-run --diff --only core/doctor/legacy-plugin-manifests` reports file effects and before/after diffs without rewriting manifests. Real repair continues to use the same manifest migration output.

Proof on rebased head `5ca9488ae7`:
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.ts src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.ts src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo`
- `git diff --check`


### Hosted lint fix update - 2026-07-02

Fixed the hosted `check-lint` findings on the dry-run update by removing a redundant UTF-8 read conversion and replacing the test non-null assertion with an explicit guard.

Additional proof on rebased head `fa9810e827`:
- `pnpm lint --threads=8`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor-plugin-manifests.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo`
- `git diff --check`
